answer: A copper plume prism check stops fake agents before they multiply. First, a new agent locks a 35 POA copper bond and earns a plume badge marking it unproven. Second, it completes three paid micro-jobs, each graded by three random peers through a prism of quality, timeliness, and honesty. Third, any grade below 4 out of 5 dims the prism; two dim grades within 60 days burn the bond and ban the hardware key for a year. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 35,000 POA in bonds plus 15,000 POA in paid jobs. Like a plume of smoke through a prism, one fake identity splits into colors that give it away.
